LanguageData.LP_Minotaur.label: minotaur
LanguageData.LP_Minotaur.description: A burly race with bull heads and horns; the bloodline is passed on to children. Minotaurs are a size bigger than ordinary people, covered in short brown fur, extremely strong and good at melee, able to gore with their horns; when they charge they're like a mad bull, sending enemies in the way flying. Legend says they're born in labyrinths, and they move faster indoors under a roof. The price is slow learning, a hot temper and an astonishing appetite.
LanguageData.LP_Minotaur.descriptionShort: Inheritable burly race. Body size ×1.3, carries a lot, strong melee, horn attacks, a bull rush once per day, indoor move speed +10%; slow learner, hot-tempered, big appetite.
